notes: Fixed legacy History batching: old episode records without download_batch_id are now inferred into batches when they share the same series, season and folder and completed in one continuous download window.
This makes existing multi-episode downloads collapse into one History entry even when they were recorded before explicit batch IDs were persisted.
Redesigned History into compact 52-58px rows so many completed batches fit on screen without excessive scrolling.
History download statistics now use the same explicit + inferred batch grouping shown in the History list.
